source: Authenticated Shopify connector run-analytics-query; shop dresslikemommy-com.myshopify.com
scope: Aggregate sessions only; no customer PII. Excluded traffic is low-intent or unverified, not a proven bot diagnosis.

total.query: FROM sessions SHOW sessions, sessions_with_cart_additions, sessions_that_reached_checkout, sessions_that_completed_checkout, conversion_rate SINCE 2026-08-25 UNTIL 2026-09-23

qualified.query: FROM sessions SHOW sessions, sessions_with_cart_additions, sessions_that_reached_checkout, sessions_that_completed_checkout, conversion_rate WHERE session_device_type = 'mobile' OR (referrer_source = 'search' AND referrer_name = 'google') SINCE 2026-08-25 UNTIL 2026-09-23

supporting_breakdowns.union_check: mobile 2158 + Google desktop 180 + Google tablet 4 = 2342 qualified sessions; matches the OR query.
